solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Counterfeit next year's coins and prosper

definitions.meaning: read literally, to fake money dated in advance of its year is to counterfeit it before its time
to prosper is to make good progress and advance steadily

explanation.walkthrough: The first definition is a playful literal reading of the phrase as forging something in advance; the second is its everyday sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to make rapid progress, which is a way of thriving or doing well.

clue.text: After first of October turn collar up in Scottish port

indicators.note: the turned-up word comes after the opening letter in the answer
the first of the month name gives only its opening letter
turn up in a down light says the word for collar is flipped to read upwards

parts.note: to collar a suspect is to nab them

explanation.surface: A tailor's instruction for October: turn your collar up against the wind in a Scottish harbour town.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'turn' with 'up' means flipping the piece so it reads bottom to top; 'up' is otherwise a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Oban is a harbour town on the west coast of Scotland, a ferry port for the Hebrides.

clue.text: Acquire husband

definitions.meaning: to acquire is to gather or collect
as a verb, to husband resources is to store and conserve them

explanation.definitionFit: To gather in means to acquire, and to store up carefully is the verb sense of husband.

clue.text: Makes legal charges

parts.note: charges here are formal accusations of wrongdoing rather than fees for a lawyer's services

explanation.definitionFit: To charge someone formally with an offence is to level an accusation at them.

clue.text: Mark turned up for school

indicators.note: in a down light, turned up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to mark something is to note it

explanation.surface: A pupil's grade appears for a school.
explanation.definitionFit: Eton College is a famous English public school near Windsor.

clue.text: Padre is sunk in gloom

indicators.note: sunk suggests the letters have been wrecked and so jumbled

explanation.surface: A priest is in low spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sunk' is the anagram signal on PADRE IS; 'in' is a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Despair and gloom are near synonyms for a state of hopelessness.

clue.text: Features of wild scenery portrayed in Brontë novel

parts.note: a heath is an open stretch of moorland
a cliff is a steep rock face

explanation.surface: Rugged landscapes are vividly described in a Brontë novel.
explanation.walkthrough: One phrase supplies both pieces, two features of wild scenery. The definition names someone portrayed in Wuthering Heights.
explanation.definitionFit: Heathcliff is the brooding hero depicted in Emily Brontë's Wuthering Heights.

clue.text: Lacking resolve, Tories rule badly

indicators.note: badly suggests the words are mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A political jibe: the Conservatives govern poorly and indecisively.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' signals an anagram of TORIES RULE; TORIES are members of Britain's Conservative Party.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone wavering and indecisive lacks firmness of purpose.

clue.text: Stagger back and get a dirty look

indicators.note: back says the word for stagger is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: to stagger is to reel

explanation.surface: Someone lurches backwards and is glared at.
explanation.definitionFit: A leer is a lascivious or unpleasant sideways glance.

clue.text: Island with many debts is unstable

parts.note: Capri is an Italian island in the Bay of Naples
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a conventional many
IOUs are written acknowledgements of debts

explanation.surface: An island nation drowning in debt is in a precarious state.
explanation.definitionFit: Capricious means changeable and unpredictable, hence unstable.

clue.text: Handy article one can get for a pound

definitions.text: Handy article one can get for a pound

parts.words: Handy article one can get for a pound
parts.note: pound means to crush rather than a sum of money, so this is a hand tool used for grinding

explanation.definitionFit: A pestle is the hand-held club used with a mortar for crushing ingredients.

clue.text: Journals I'd taken back to sign

indicators.note: taken back says the short phrase is read in reverse

parts.note: Aries is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: A diarist's notebooks returned to be autographed.
explanation.definitionFit: Diaries are personal journals kept day by day.

clue.text: Girl allowed aunt in Paris to be a dabbler

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, short for Diana
to let is to allow
tante is French for aunt

explanation.surface: A girl was permitted by her French aunt to try a little of everything.
explanation.definitionFit: A dilettante dabbles in an art or subject without serious commitment.

clue.text: They attack with wild Alsatians with safety first

indicators.note: wild suggests the letters are running loose in disorder
first takes just the opening letter of safety

explanation.surface: Fierce guard dogs go for intruders, though safety comes first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wild' signals an anagram of ALSATIANS plus S, the first letter of 'safety'; ALSATIANS are German shepherd dogs.
explanation.definitionFit: Assailants are people who attack others.

clue.text: Shy in disposition, but bright

indicators.note: disposition read as arrangement says the letters are set out afresh

explanation.surface: Someone is timid by nature, but clever.
explanation.definitionFit: Shiny means glossy and gleaming, so bright.

clue.text: An oppressive blow for the Italians

definitions.text: An oppressive blow for the Italians

parts.words: An oppressive blow for the Italians
parts.note: the blow is a stifling hot wind that sweeps across the Mediterranean to Italy, not a punch

explanation.definitionFit: The sirocco is a hot, dusty wind from North Africa that reaches southern Italy.

clue.text: Boast about hand-made footwear

indicators.note: about suggests the letters are turned around and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone brags about their craft-made shoes.
explanation.definitionFit: A sabot is a wooden clog traditionally carved by hand.

clue.text: Cut and share out

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are put out of their usual order

explanation.surface: Divide something and hand out portions.
explanation.definitionFit: To shear is to cut, as with wool from sheep.

clue.text: Having gone astray see a way to follow

indicators.note: the word for way follows the word for see in the answer

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or see
St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A lost traveller spots a route to take.
explanation.definitionFit: Lost describes something or someone that has strayed and cannot be found.

clue.text: Place to use deception at university

parts.note: to lie is to deceive

explanation.surface: Somewhere to cheat while at college.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Place' is the definition in the sense of 'in place of', as in 'in lieu of'.
explanation.definitionFit: Lieu means place, surviving in the phrase in lieu of, meaning instead of.

clue.text: Mind someone else's business?

parts.note: minding here means prying into rather than looking after another person's affairs

explanation.definitionFit: To snoop is to pry nosily into matters that do not concern you.

clue.text: RAF's set to scramble in attacks

indicators.note: scramble means mix up, signalling the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Air Force crews are ready to take off quickly on raids.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to scramble' looks like the RAF launching fighters but signals an anagram of RAFS SET; the RAF is Britain's Royal Air Force.
explanation.definitionFit: To strafe is to attack with gunfire from low-flying aircraft.

clue.text: For one in ten it is essential to the diet

definitions.text: it is essential to the diet

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: in places the numeral for one within the word for ten

parts.note: taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A dietary statistic: one in ten considers it vital.
explanation.definitionFit: Protein is a nutrient the body needs, an essential part of any diet.

clue.text: Group of three attempt to go round in it

indicators.note: the word for attempt goes round the remaining two short words

parts.note: a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: Three people try to encircle something.
explanation.definitionFit: A trinity is a set of three, as in the Holy Trinity.

clue.text: Kind of shirt with frill — very tasteful

parts.note: T as in T-shirt
a ruffle is a frill on clothing

explanation.surface: A fashion note: a shirt trimmed with frills is in excellent taste.
explanation.walkthrough: 'very tasteful' is a playful definition: a truffle is a delicacy full of taste, not a stylish garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A truffle, the fungus or the chocolate, is prized for its rich flavour.

clue.text: Portly pet — one getting too much bread?

parts.note: portly means fat
a cat is a common pet

explanation.surface: An overweight pet is being overfed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bread' is slang for money: a fat cat is an overpaid executive.
explanation.definitionFit: A fat cat is a wealthy person, especially one paid excessively.

clue.text: Cold state of something oven-baked

definitions.meaning: a chilly US state in the far north
baked ... is a dessert of ice cream in meringue browned in the oven

explanation.definitionFit: Alaska is the northernmost US state, and gives its name to the baked dessert.

clue.text: It's up to Rex to make a move

indicators.note: in a down light, up says the letters read upwards

parts.note: R stands for Rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: The king decides when it is time to act.
explanation.definitionFit: To stir is to move slightly, as in not stirring from bed.

clue.text: Shellfish left in river

indicators.note: in places the letter for left inside the river's name

parts.note: the Cam is the river through Cambridge

explanation.surface: Seafood abandoned in a stream.
explanation.definitionFit: A clam is a bivalve mollusc, a type of shellfish.

clue.text: The prodigal son's return fare

parts.note: the fare is food served at a homecoming feast rather than a ticket price for the journey

explanation.walkthrough: In the Bible parable the father kills a fattened calf to celebrate his wayward son's return.
explanation.definitionFit: Killing the fatted calf is the celebratory meal laid on for the returning prodigal.

clue.text: He opposed Stalin and survived to write about it

indicators.note: about says the first short word is written around the second

explanation.surface: A dissident defied the Soviet dictator and lived to tell the tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'survived to write about it' looks like the idiom for living to tell the tale; the last three words are the container instruction instead.
explanation.definitionFit: Josip Broz Tito broke with Stalin in 1948 and remained Yugoslavia's leader until his death.

clue.text: The shooting season

parts.note: shooting refers to plants putting out new shoots rather than to hunting with guns

explanation.definitionFit: Spring is the season when plants sprout fresh growth.
